title: Valar Atomics technology tabs
description: A two-half intro over a wide black panel (4px corners) that grows a short tab down towards the active one of three big labels below it. Every few seconds the next part takes over: the tab slides across with a sharp ease, the panel's media crossfades, the active label turns black with a gold eyebrow and the rest dim to half. On phones the label row runs off the screen and slides to the active one.
notes: needs JavaScript for the auto-advance (static HTML shows the first item active); it pauses on hover and under reduced motion, and the labels are buttons
the panel and tab are one clipped `dark` shape (black on a light page); its media slot is 363×440 on phones and 1270×440 at 1440, tab included
made for three items; more work but the tab gets crowded
name: valaratomics-core

props.name: items
props.description: the parts the panel cycles through (three in the original)

props.name: interval
props.description: seconds each item stays before the next one takes over
